title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: This release stops Remove Test Only Code from deleting tests that also cover live code through class members.

highlights.title: Tests of live members kept
highlights.description: Remove Test Only Code no longer offers to delete a test that calls live class members, even when the test also checks the member being removed.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Remove Test Only Code offering to delete tests of live code. Seven tests of EditionDatabaseHelperTest save and read back editions through live members, and each also asserts isDownloadingZip, a member only tests used: all seven were planned for removal with it, because the guard only looked for top level names and a member call never tripped it. A test is now kept when it names a class member declared outside what the removal takes; the members of a removed class still go with it, and the words of a test's own name are not counted.
